fix(swan): skip blank STAC icons from missing shell item.icon (#183)

After Swan stopped putting icon on shell data, older templates that still
read `${item.icon}` interpolate to an empty name. Official STAC then logs
"The Icon  does not exist." Replace those widgets with an empty sized box
before parse.
